scope_note: SG-CS-PRESCRIPTION-SPECIAL-RULES after a correction following the V10K audit. For a nonresident prescriber's staged Schedule II prescriptions the section now keeps the statutory wording of M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 18(d) and (d1/2) (filled only if issued within the preceding five days; silent on do-not-fill-before dates) and adds, as Board of Registration in Pharmacy guidance framed like its existing 30-day reading, the December 2025 newsletter's statement that such prescriptions are valid for five days from the date of issuance or the do-not-fill-before date, as applicable; the newsletter's publication statement says its views are not necessarily the Board's official views unless expressly stated. Changed: orientation[5], comparison_tables[1].rows[3], comparison_tables[6].rows[2], quick_review[9], retrieval_prompts[11], timing_deadlines[4], decision_logic[8], role_duties[5] and common_traps[8]; entries about a prescription with no do-not-fill-before date still count from issuance. New rule: MA-OUTSTATE-CII-MULTIPLE-RX-WINDOW; MA-OUTSTATE-CII-FILL-WINDOW is now cited in orientation[5]. Scope gate: the same four actionable signals as the previous freeze are declined; FED-OUD-OTP and MA-CS-QUANTITY-II-III are records this section already replaced, and MA-DPH-REGISTRANT-SCOPE and MA-PMP-STATUTORY-FRAMEWORK are neighbours of the 105 CMR 700.001 citation outside the declared scope. All 21 practice links stay.
